subject: Re: Kickoff: SQIF factoring evaluation (Q2)
body:
Lucia — resourcing for the plan.

Staffing: Rosa 50%, Farah 40%, Giannis 40%, Halima 60% through June.

Compute: bruteforce baselines are CPU-bound and run on standard pools. The June QAOA sweeps are the expensive part — we simulate circuits across qaoa_depth 1-8 with num_samples up to 10k per configuration — and we've sized that to the big accelerator slice: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-15, 384 accelerators, which covers the full sweep grid with margin.

Ask: freeze the sweep configs by Jun 8 so we don't burn reserved capacity on config churn. One more line item — 5TB object storage for sampled low-energy states.

If the harness slips past Mar 16 the whole tail compresses, so flag early.

Bruno
